verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-infrastructure platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.browserbase.com/integrations/mcp/introduction, which directly delivers the story's core. Missing for 10: details on the MCP server's tools, transport/setup and supported clients, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent through it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
